name: gpt-bridge
description: Expose your VS Code workspace as an MCP server so ChatGPT can read and edit your code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: This extension exposes the local filesystem to an external service, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

gptBridge.port.description: Port the MCP server binds to on 127.0.0.1.

gptBridge.autoStart.description: Start the server automatically when VS Code launches.

gptBridge.tunnel.provider.description: Tunnel provider the extension starts on its own. Default "none": the extension does not create a tunnel, which is right when you use an external tunnel such as OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel, or want to stay local-only. Set "cloudflare" to have the extension run cloudflared and obtain a public URL.

gptBridge.tunnel.hostname.description: Public hostname of a Named Tunnel (e.g. bridge.example.com). It cannot be derived from the token, so set it here. Leave empty for a Quick Tunnel.

enumDescriptions: Auto-approve for the rest of the session after the first approval. Cleared when the extension reloads.
gptBridge.approval.mode.description: How write operations are approved. delete_path always asks, in every mode.

gptBridge.approval.autoApprovePatterns.description: Path globs auto-approved in pattern mode.

gptBridge.approval.timeoutSeconds.description: Deny a request after this many seconds without an answer. The dialog stays on screen; a choice made after expiry is discarded.

gptBridge.autoSave.description: Save automatically after GPT edits. Leave off to keep disk unchanged until Ctrl+S (recommended).

gptBridge.deny.extraPatterns.description: Extra globs added to the built-in deny list. Built-in entries cannot be removed.

gptBridge.maxReadBytes.description: Maximum bytes read_file may return in one call.

gptBridge.language.description: Language for the panel, status bar and dialogs. Logs and tool descriptions stay in English.

gptBridge.commandExecution.enabled.description: Enable the local run_command MCP tool. Commands always require explicit approval and run with the VS Code user's OS privileges.

gptBridge.commandExecution.allowedExecut.description: Bare executable names allowed for run_command. Add powershell.exe or pwsh.exe only if you explicitly want full shell execution.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run build:prod
